We want your ideas, not just your dials. Which buyers respond? Which message lands? What should we test next? If you have a strategy, pitch it. If it works, we run it.What you bringAt least 1 year of calling into the US market. You've made the dials, heard the "not interested," and know how US buyers think, talk, and decide.B2B experience. SaaS is a plus. B2B services selling into the US works too.Comfort with a no. Rejection doesn't slow you down. It gives you data.Clear, simple communication. You can explain a technical product without drowning someone in jargon.A bias to act on what you learn. More on this below.How we'll know you're the one:Everyone says they're curious. We'd rather see it.The people who do well here try something, notice what happened, and change their approach the next day. They rewrite a call opener after five bad calls. They find a pattern in who picks up. They test a new subject line because the old one went quiet.Why this role is worth it:You'll sell something buyers need right now: AI they can trust with their data.Your ideas shape how we go to market. Not in a year. Now.You'll talk to senior US leaders every day. That's a fast education.Clear path for top performers to grow into AE and GTM strategy roles.How to applySend your resume the usual way.Or, if you want to stand out: find the right person at Libra and reach out to them directly, the way you'd reach a prospect. Make your case for why you're the one for this role.

Headquarters: Atlanta, Georgia
 
URL: https://www.spiralyze.com/

We’re looking for a video editor to help create sharp, premium LinkedIn videos about A/B testing, CRO, landing pages, and design.

This is founder-led content. Most videos will include talking-head footage, screen recordings, website examples, captions, charts, and simple motion graphics.

Key Responsibilities

• Edit short LinkedIn videos, usually 30 seconds to 3 minutes

• Turn raw footage into polished, engaging social content

• Add captions, callouts, zooms, screenshots, charts, and simple motion graphics

• Apply clean, consistent color grading to maintain a polished look

• Enhance audio with basic sound design and leveling

• Make business and data-heavy topics feel clear and visually interesting

• Create strong openings that hook viewers in the first few seconds

• Repurpose longer recordings into short clips

• Maintain a clean, premium, data-driven brand style

• Communicate clearly with a U.S.-based team and respond well to feedback

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• 2+ years of professional video editing experience

• Strong portfolio of social media videos

• Excellent sense of pacing, storytelling, captions, and visual hierarchy

• Experience editing talking-head, educational, or business content

• Strong skills in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or similar

• Good written English

• Reliable, organized, and able to work independently

Nice to Have

• Experience with B2B, SaaS, marketing, design, or tech content

• Motion graphics or After Effects skills

• Familiarity with LinkedIn and YouTube editing styles

• Interest in A/B testing, CRO, UX, or digital marketing

Benefits

• Growth path. We invest heavily in developing our people and promote almost exclusively from within. Success in this role leads to building and leading an entire content and brand team.

• In-demand skills. You’ll work alongside one of the most experienced experimentation teams in the world and learn how data, psychology, and creative intersect.

• Tech reimbursement. Need a better computer, monitor, or setup?  We’ll help.

• Time to recharge. 20 days of paid vacation plus holidays.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/spiralyze-video-editor-linkedin-content-1
